hints.title: Enumerate Powers of Two
hints.text: The maximum value is 2^20, so the sum of two deliciousness values is at most 2^21.

hints.title: Two-Sum Frequency Complement
hints.text: For each element x, check how many previous elements equal target - x for all 22 powers of two.

hints.title: Modulo Arithmetic
hints.text: Accumulate valid pairs modulo 10^9 + 7 and maintain running frequencies.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: n is length of deliciousness array
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all pairs takes O(n^2) quadratic time, exceeding limits for n = 10^5.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Checking at most 22 powers of two against a frequency map takes O(22n) time and O(n) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate notes that sums can only reach 2^21, bounding power-of-two lookups to 22 targets.

solutions.approach: Bounded power of two complement lookup with frequency map
